author: Arachadonic
body:
Okay so my idea is this:

Have a command prehaps like "/tchat (message)" that will only send the message to member on your team.

I feel like this is missing from Nebula badly as there have often been times when I have wanted to tell my team something of strategic importance but could not as the chat can be viewed by both teams.
It is possible to do and it is a small idea that I think could make the game 100% better and feel more like a match. It would give the game a greater sense of co-operation and teamwork.

Thanks! Feel free to share your opinions below!

There is a command like this already, just do /c t
and then /c g to switch back to global chat.
